review_candidates.title: Senior System Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Administer Active Directory Domain Services, AD replication, Sites & Services, Kerberos/Windows authentication, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy. Build and maintain automation and infrastructure-as-code to improve reliability, consistency, and operational efficiency (PowerShell, Python, Bash, Terraform, or similar). Maintain enough VMware/virtualization depth to troubleshoot across the full infrastructure stack. Microsoft 365 & Modern Workplace Support and help evolve core Microsoft 365 collaboration
eligibility_evidence: Our client is hiring a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to help design, run, and modernize an enterprise technology environment that spans on-premises Windows infrastructure, Azure/hybrid cloud, Microsoft 365, and day-to-day IT operations.
Cloud, Hybrid & Automation Design, deploy, and support hybrid infrastructure across Azure (and/or AWS) and on-premises environments.
Support cloud security, identity, and governance, and contribute to hybrid architecture decisions.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role is intentionally broad: we're looking for strong infrastructure engineers first, and are open to candidates whose deepest expertise sits in any one of several adjacent specialties — traditional Windows/Active Directory environments, cloud and automation engineering, Microsoft 365 and the modern workplace, or infrastructure operations and support. Strong candidates typically bring deep, hands-on strength in one or two of these domains, plus working familiarity across the rest.
